name: application-deployment-timeline
title: Deployment Timeline
description: Vertical timeline of deployment events with commit hash, author, environment badge, and a Rollback action that only appears on past deploys, never the current one.
useWhen: Showing a chronological history of deployments to an environment with commit and author metadata.
Users need a one-click rollback affordance on any past deploy, but never on the currently-live one.
You want exactly one entry visually marked as "Current", computed from real deploy state.
avoidWhen: You need general code-change history without deployment semantics — use version-history-list instead.
There's no rollback action and no environment context — a plain activity-feed is simpler.
You need to show multiple environments side by side — pair this with tabs or a per-environment filter.
responsiveBehavior: The timeline is a single-column vertical list; entry metadata (commit, environment, current badge) wraps onto multiple lines on narrow viewports.
accessibility: The timeline is a real ordered list (<ol>) so assistive tech announces each deploy's position and total count.
The current deploy is marked with both a colored dot/ring and an explicit "Current" badge, not color alone.
The Rollback action only renders for non-current entries, so it never offers to roll back to the already-live deploy.

variants.title: Deployment timeline
variants.description: Three production deploys with the newest marked Current and rollback actions on the two older entries, on a light surface.
accessibility: The connecting line between dots is decorative (aria-hidden); the ordered list structure carries the sequence.

variants.title: Deployment timeline (Dark)
variants.description: The same three-deploy timeline, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Dot, badge, and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
